text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, The day of my debut's finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Not going to lie, I was so worried about whether I'll live up to my fans' expectations that my heart was close to exploding.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But when I thought about how everybody back home sent me off, it gave me the energy I needed to make this a debut to remember!
